meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 会以编排者身份工作,把实施工作派给子代理:每个子代理一个明确目标,需回报所运行的命令、输出与改动文件;每阶段结束派子代理做验证、反模式检查和代码质量审查,验证通过才提交,阶段之间再同步分支。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时触发,尤其是由 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 执行这份计划,按阶段派子代理来做,每阶段验证通过再提交。
say.note: 会逐阶段派发子代理并跑验证清单。

say.text: 用子代理继续执行计划的下一个阶段。
say.note: 同步分支后启动下一阶段的子代理。

say.text: 先验证这一阶段的改动,再决定要不要提交。
say.note: 派验证子代理跑清单,通过才提交。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as orchestrator: all work goes to subagents, each with one objective and required evidence (commands, outputs, files changed). After each phase it verifies, checks anti-patterns, reviews code, and commits only on passing.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to execute, run or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan phase by phase with subagents, verifying before each commit.
say_en.note: Runs subagent verification before each commit.

say_en.text: Use subagents to run the next phase of the plan.
say_en.note: Syncs the branch, then starts next-phase subagents.

say_en.text: Verify this phase's changes before committing.
say_en.note: Sends a verification subagent, commits only if it passes.
